title: project-marker
description: Identity of a project inside its repository (.swissknifeman/project.json), committed with the project. It names the workspace and the project by code and says where the plans live; it holds no path.

workspace.description: Code of the workspace that holds the project (the folder name under workspaces/).

project_id.description: Project code: the folder name under projects/ of the workspace; usually the name of the checkout folder.

plans_store.description: Where the plans of the project live: `legacy` is <project>/plans, `workspace` is the portable workspace. The one switch of the store.
